extension.description: Keep your CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, .cursorrules and AGENTS.md files in one cloud-synced library, organize them with labels, and load them into any project without leaving VS Code.
configuration.statusBar.enabled.descript: Show a LoreHub item in the status bar. It displays whether you are signed in, and clicking it signs you in or out.
command.login.title: Login with GitHub
command.logout.title: Logout
command.openMdPanel.title: Open My Library
command.loadToProject.title: Load md into Project
walkthrough.title: Get started with LoreHub
walkthrough.description: Sign in, open your cloud-synced library of AI config files, and load one into the project you are working on.
walkthrough.signIn.title: Sign in with GitHub
walkthrough.signIn.description:
Your library lives with your account, not with this machine, so the same md files are waiting on every computer you sign in from.
[Sign in with GitHub](command:lorehub.login)
walkthrough.signIn.altText: Two computers sharing one cloud-synced md library
walkthrough.openLibrary.title: Open your md library
walkthrough.openLibrary.description:
Browse, write and organise your CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md and .cursorrules files in one panel. Labels keep them findable once the collection grows.
[Open My Library](command:lorehub.openMdPanel)
walkthrough.openLibrary.altText: The LoreHub panel: labels, a file list and an editor
walkthrough.loadIntoProject.title: Load an md into this project
walkthrough.loadIntoProject.description:
Pick a file from your library and write it into the folder you choose. Right-clicking a folder in the Explorer loads straight into it.
[Load md into Project](command:lorehub.loadToProject)
walkthrough.loadIntoProject.altText: An md file moving from the library into a project folder
